units.function: Embedded-PostgreSQL tests for a derived Issue-reference index spanning Issue fields, comments and attached Documents, including inbound/outbound aggregation, source deletion and company backfill.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> issueReferenceService -> Drizzle/PostgreSQL Issues, comments, Documents, Issue-Document links and reference-mention projection; tests create the projection table locally.
units.keyDataModels: Reference mention keyed by company/source Issue/target Issue/source kind/source record; matched text and optional Document key; grouped reference summary with target Issue, mention count and labeled sources.
units.lifecycle: Parse references on Issue/comment/Document sync -> replace or append source-scoped mention rows -> aggregate inbound/outbound summaries; remove a Document source independently; rebuild all current references for a company from authoritative records.
units.testAssessment: Both tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs because embedded PostgreSQL was unavailable. Intended coverage proves multi-source aggregation, self-reference omission, source-level deletion and legacy backfill. It does not cover cross-tenant attacks, authorization, edits/deletes beyond one Document source, soft deletion/restoration, identifier rename, dangling/cyclic links, concurrent sync, transactional failure or immutable evidence semantics.
units.designRationale: Keep textual Issue references discoverable and explainable without reparsing all rich text on every read, while retaining enough source provenance to update one contributor and rebuild the projection.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs navigable links among Work, goals, approvals, evidence and results, plus rebuildable read projections; responsibility evidence itself must remain immutable, tenant-safe and bound to exact policy/action/digests.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the source-attributed, rebuildable projection pattern for non-authoritative navigation. Parse into stable opaque entity IDs through tenant-scoped resolvers, emit versioned projection events and support deterministic repair. Never treat matched text or this mutable projection as evidence; store evidence objects and responsibility-chain digests in an append-only authoritative ledger with separate access policy.
units.responsibilityConflict: The mutable mention table records discoverability, not who authorized or attested an action. Backfill from current text can erase historical meaning, and no accountable-human, approval, permission/data-scope or evidence digest is bound to a reference.
evidence: git history: ab9051b595be21dcfab93a4c02ff65548a6341ff Add first-class issue references (#4214)
units.securityFindings: HIGH tenant/auth gap: no adversarial company-boundary or permission test. HIGH evidence-semantic risk: matched mutable text cannot be an authoritative responsibility record. HIGH verification gap: both real-database tests skipped. MEDIUM lifecycle gap: edits, soft delete/restore, detach/rekey/revision and identifier rename are absent. MEDIUM consistency gap: no concurrent/idempotent/transaction failure test. POSITIVE: company_id, source-level provenance, cascades and rebuildability are useful projection primitives.
